rear_cover.method: Rigid Rx/Y/Z point-to-plane alignment of original exterior reference triangles to rough whole rear; X mirror plane preserved. Same transform applies to nominal rear without fitting away deliberate straightening.

whole_frame.frame: X=0 optimized outer-frame bilateral plane; Y toward top opposite connector/button end, Z front; Y/Z centered by robust end/face bounds, not mass centroid
whole_frame.orientation_status: whole front identified by visible display/buttons; body front inferred from corresponding raw source orientation and must be verified from mating features
whole_frame.assembly_status: independent rigid canonical pose only; no fit/congruence between front/back interfaces asserted
whole_frame.alignment_method: Robust reflected nearest-surface point-plane residual using outward side rails and paired end outline, excluding inner tabs and tiny disconnected components
